selection_rule: Chosen by held-out fertility and byte-fallback rate, then constrained by the ~25M-parameter model budget the assignment sets for Phase 2. Fertility keeps improving up to 48k (1.226 vs 1.272 at 32k), but with weight tying the embedding matrix is vocab_size x d_model: at 48k it would consume ~18.4M of the 25M budget and leave only ~6.6M for the Transformer layers, against ~12.3M/~12.7M at 32k. A 3.6% fertility gain does not justify surrendering a quarter of the model.
note_vs_hindi: Hindi saturates earlier: its 48k vocabulary sits 78.6% utilised, so 32k was selected on fertility grounds alone. Nepali's 48k vocabulary is still 91.5% utilised, indicating it would continue to benefit from a larger vocabulary. Nepali is morphologically richer and segments less efficiently at every size (1.552 vs 1.388 tokens/word at 8k).
